prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, company size and the specific services you need (SEO, paid media, content, social, creative, growth engineering, etc.).

If you want a quick, useful next step, tell me a few details and I’ll recommend a short, tailored list:
- Primary goal (lead generation, brand awareness, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, etc.)
- Main channels/services you need (paid search/social, SEO, content, email, creative, analytics)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget
- Company stage/size and industry
- Preference for agency size or culture (startup/growth-focused vs enterprise/full-service)

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use this checklist when comparing candidates:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for businesses like yours (goal, approach, KPI improvements)
- Client retention and references (ask for a client you can call)
- Depth of expertise for the channels you care about (certifications, tools, team bios)
- Reporting cadence and what metrics they’ll own
- Pricing model and minimum contract length / exit terms
- Availability and team structure (day-to-day contact, senior involvement)
- Creative + technical capabilities if you need both (landing pages, analytics, tracking)
- Cultural fit and communication style

Questions to ask agencies in an intro call:
- What specific KPIs would you propose for our goal and why?
- Can you show 1–2 case studies with before/after metrics?
- Who on your team will be our day-to-day contact and what are their backgrounds?
- What tools and platforms do you use for tracking, reporting and campaign optimization?
- How do you charge and what’s included in the fee?
- How do you measure and report ROI?

If you want, tell me the details above and I’ll put together a shortlist of 4–6 San Francisco agencies that match your needs plus a short outreach template you can send to them. Which option do you prefer?
